en.title: Schedule Meeting
en.description:
Given each employee's busy intervals within a day and the meeting length, find the earliest start minute at which all employees are free and the meeting can finish within the day; if there is none, output -1. Added by this site: times use half-open intervals [start,finish), so touching endpoints do not conflict; input intervals may overlap or be out of order.

The parts marked 'added by this site' and the standard input/output protocol were explicitly compiled by this site; they do not mean the original problem has other unstated rules.
en.input: The first line contains n length; for each employee, the number of intervals m is given, followed by m pairs start finish. 1≤n≤100, 0≤m≤100, 0≤start<finish≤1400, 1≤length≤1440.
en.output: Output the earliest start time; if no time works, output -1.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
hints: First separate each rule of the original problem from the input conventions added by this site, then choose a suitable data structure.
